audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[N].side is 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content win[N] is 'Morgana' on all 7 rows — the two layers already contradict each other before touching winRate at all.
audit.why: Black Shield hard-counters Rocket Grab and the content whys/spikes already ground a Morgana-favored lane in real kit facts (E absorbs Q, Dark Binding out-ranges the walk-up, Soul Shackles punishes E-range commits). The full-layer side/rating/why are unedited generic template text that never got moved off 'Skill'.
audit.corrected: Move all 7 full phases[N].side to 'Morgana' with matching ratings and kit-grounded why text (see edits) so both layers agree with the existing, better-grounded content win[N] row.

audit.why: Level 2 all-in denial via Black Shield, level 6 Soul Shackles punish, and the first-item CDR keeping the shield up are already named with real ability tags in the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carries no cooldown numbers despite Dark Binding (10s), Black Shield (26-16s) and Soul Shackles (120-100s) all being matchup-defining. missingInteractions also flags Black Shield as terrain that cuts retreat, but Black Shield's Riot text (barrier that absorbs damage/CC) has no terrain or path-blocking effect — likely a flag misfire, not acted on.
audit.why: enemyKit gives exact per-rank cooldowns for all three abilities.

edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Overdrive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Dark Binding (Q) is down just 10s — minion-block it, the duo's tempo bends around its reset. - Black Shield (E) blocks your whole kit; bait it before committing Rocket Grab. - Soul Shackles (R) is 120-100s — punish the long window it's missing.
